zh: 智能体流式生成时待审批卡片常驻停靠在输入框上方，避免被长回答冲刷出视野；完成审批后平滑归位至对话记录。
优化智能体雷达弹窗定位与视口自适应，修复侧栏拖拽与滚动时的遮挡问题；增强桌面端工作区面板标题吸顶。
技能自我进化（save_skill）支持工作区长文本草稿读取，优化上下文压缩预算与单步输出超限保护。
工具中心新增「非内置」来源分类筛选与专属高亮标识，完善键盘导航与搜索框轮廓无障碍体验。
en: Pending approval cards remain docked above the composer while responses stream, preventing them from scrolling offscreen, and smoothly return to history once settled.
Refined Agent Radar popover positioning with viewport boundary clamping during sidebar resize and scroll, and added sticky workspace panel headers on desktop.
Skill evolution (save_skill) supports workspace drafts for large skills, and improves context compaction headroom and output truncation recovery.
Added Non-builtin source filtering and distinct badge styling in Skill Hub, with refined keyboard focus-visible outlines for search input.
